status_semantics.proved: complete written argument with independent internal review; not a compiled formal theorem or external publication

questions.question: Q851

questions.exact_retained_statement: Close the minimax gap Ω(n/(ε log n)) versus O((n/(ε log n))min{log(1/ε), log n}) for distinguishing d_n(p)=0 from d_n(p)>ε.
questions.remaining: Close the epsilon-dependent logarithmic gap in the non-tolerant sample complexity.

questions.question: Q856
questions.title: The exact minimax constant for unseen probability mass
questions.exact_retained_statement: For iid X₁: n∼p on an unrestricted countable alphabet, let M₀=Σ_xp_x1{N_x=0} and R_n*=inf_Mhat sup_p E_p[(Mhat−M₀)²]. Does lim_n nR_n* exist, and is it c_u=max_{x∈(0, 1]} x e^(−x)(1−e^(−x))²/[1−e^(−x)−x e^(−x)]≈0.570077, the uniform-family constant?
original_assumptions: infimum over all estimators in the original target
questions.remaining: Prove existence/value of the unrestricted minimax limit; the fixed finite linear class cannot settle it.

questions.question: Q858
questions.title: Gaussian uncertainty for distinct entities observed in pairs
questions.exact_retained_statement: For iid unordered pairs E_i of distinct natural numbers with arbitrary fixed law μ, set V_n=∪_{i≤n}E_i. Does Var(|V_n|)→∞ imply (|V_n|−E|V_n|)/sqrt(Var(|V_n|))⇒N(0, 1), without eventual connectedness? This is the loopless countable-support model, without dust.
original_assumptions: iid unordered pairs of distinct natural numbers
questions.remaining: Exact assigned CLT answered by written proof. Variance estimation, finite-sample inference and broader hyperedge models remain separate.

finite-n bias terms retained or growing regime stated
